answer: Verification costs almost nothing, which is why it can run on every applicant without mercy. One honest proof costs 66 POA; one farm proof costs the same, but the farm needs 825 of them, which comes to 54450 POA. The farm's river arrived yesterday, its terrace arrived this morning, and its juniper never arrived at all. Let every applicant face the same trial with Atlas binder sea chart warrant charted on the map room, and let the answer read as each sea chart is a year of chart logs in the survey ledger. Honest proofs grow like seed; farm proofs are sawdust, and sawdust grows nothing.
